Third-party material in Inkwell

This file and the licence files it names are installed with the app, in its resource folder under
licenses/ (see "resources" in src-tauri/tauri.conf.json).

Inkwell itself
  Copyright (C) 2026 Berkay. Licensed under the GNU Affero General Public License, version 3 or (at your option)
  any later version: licenses/LICENSE-AGPL-3.0.txt. Source: https://github.com/Berkay2002/inkwell

MuPDF 1.27.2
  Copyright (C) 2004-2025 Artifex Software, Inc.
  Licensed under the GNU Affero General Public License, version 3 or later: licenses/LICENSE-AGPL-3.0.txt
  MuPDF is the PDF engine, statically linked, with its built-in URW Nimbus base-14 fonts. The source is in
  vendor/mupdf-sys/mupdf in Inkwell's source, and Inkwell's modifications are listed in
  third_party/mupdf/MODIFICATIONS.md there.

  MuPDF links these libraries, built from the copies in vendor/mupdf-sys/mupdf/thirdparty:
  - extract and jbig2dec: Copyright (C) Artifex Software, Inc.; AGPL-3.0: licenses/LICENSE-AGPL-3.0.txt
  - FreeType: Portions of this software are copyright (C) The FreeType Project (www.freetype.org).
    All rights reserved. Used under the FreeType License (FTL): licenses/mupdf/freetype/LICENSE.TXT
  - HarfBuzz: "Old MIT" licence: licenses/mupdf/harfbuzz/COPYING
  - Little CMS 2: Copyright (c) Marti Maria Saguer; MIT licence: licenses/mupdf/lcms2/LICENSE
  - IJG libjpeg: This software is based in part on the work of the Independent JPEG Group.
  - OpenJPEG: BSD 2-clause licence: licenses/mupdf/openjpeg/LICENSE
  - zlib: Copyright (C) 1995-2022 Jean-loup Gailly and Mark Adler; zlib licence: licenses/mupdf/zlib/LICENSE
  - Brotli: Copyright (c) the Brotli Authors; MIT licence: licenses/mupdf/brotli/LICENSE
  - MuJS: Copyright (c) 2013-2020 Artifex Software, Inc.; ISC licence: licenses/mupdf/mujs/COPYING
  - Tesseract: Apache License 2.0: licenses/mupdf/tesseract/LICENSE
  - Leptonica: Copyright (C) 2001 Leptonica. All rights reserved.
    Redistribution and use in source and binary forms, with or without modification, are permitted provided
    that the following conditions are met:
    1. Redistributions of source code must retain the above copyright notice, this list of conditions and the
       following disclaimer.
    2. Redistributions in binary form must reproduce the above copyright notice, this list of conditions and
       the following disclaimer in the documentation and/or other materials provided with the distribution.
    THIS SOFTWARE IS PROVIDED BY THE COPYRIGHT HOLDERS AND CONTRIBUTORS ``AS IS'' AND ANY EXPRESS OR IMPLIED
    WARRANTIES, INCLUDING, BUT NOT LIMITED TO, THE IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND FITNESS FOR A
    PARTICULAR PURPOSE ARE DISCLAIMED. IN NO EVENT SHALL ANY CONTRIBUTORS BE LIABLE FOR ANY DIRECT, INDIRECT,
    INCIDENTAL, SPECIAL, EXEMPLARY, OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES (INCLUDING, BUT NOT LIMITED TO, PROCUREMENT OF
    SUBSTITUTE GOODS OR SERVICES; LOSS OF USE, DATA, OR PROFITS; OR BUSINESS INTERRUPTION) HOWEVER CAUSED AND ON
    ANY THEORY OF LIABILITY, WHETHER IN CONTRACT, STRICT LIABILITY, OR TORT (INCLUDING NEGLIGENCE OR OTHERWISE)
    ARISING IN ANY WAY OUT OF THE USE OF THIS SOFTWARE, EVEN IF ADVISED OF THE POSSIBILITY OF SUCH DAMAGE.

mupdf and mupdf-sys 0.8.0 (Rust bindings to MuPDF)
  Copyright (C) the mupdf-rs authors (https://github.com/messense/mupdf-rs)
  Licensed under the GNU Affero General Public License, version 3: licenses/LICENSE-AGPL-3.0.txt
  Vendored and modified in vendor/mupdf and vendor/mupdf-sys; the changes are listed in
  third_party/mupdf/MODIFICATIONS.md in Inkwell's source.

Tesseract glyphless font
  Copyright Zdenko Podobny. Licensed under the Apache License 2.0: licenses/mupdf/tesseract/LICENSE
  The one-glyph font of Tesseract's src/api/pdf_ttf.h is compiled into the app (src-tauri/src/ocr/glyphless.rs)
  and used for the invisible text layer that text recognition adds.

Rust crates and npm packages
  The app links about 300 Rust crates and bundles a few npm packages (React, react-dom, zustand, the Tauri API),
  under MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD, Zlib, BSL-1.0, MPL-2.0, Unicode-3.0 and similar licences. Each one's licence and
  notices are in licenses/RUST-AND-NPM-DEPENDENCIES.txt (generated by third_party/dependency-licenses.mjs).

Noto Sans, Noto Sans Mono
  Copyright 2022 The Noto Project Authors (https://github.com/notofonts/latin-greek-cyrillic)
  Licensed under the SIL Open Font License, Version 1.1: licenses/OFL-NotoSans.txt
  Subsets of NotoSans-Regular/Bold/Italic/BoldItalic and NotoSansMono-Regular/Bold are compiled into the
  app as fallback faces for editing text (sources and ranges: third_party/fonts/README.md in the source).

Noto Sans CJK
  Copyright 2014-2021 Adobe (http://www.adobe.com/), with Reserved Font Name 'Source'.
  Licensed under the SIL Open Font License, Version 1.1: licenses/OFL-NotoSansCJK.txt
  A subset of NotoSansCJKsc-Regular is compiled into the app as the fallback face for CJK text.

pdfcraft
  Parts of Inkwell's source are adapted from pdfcraft, licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0:
  licenses/pdfcraft/LICENSE-MIT, licenses/pdfcraft/LICENSE-APACHE and licenses/pdfcraft/NOTICE.
  The adapted files are listed in third_party/pdfcraft/INKWELL-NOTICE.txt in the source.

Fluent UI System Icons
  Copyright (c) 2020 Microsoft Corporation
  Licensed under the MIT licence: licenses/fluent/LICENSE-MIT
  The interface icons in src/assets/icons/fluent/ are copied from @fluentui/svg-icons (see docs/icons.md).

OpenAI and Claude marks
  The two marks beside the assistant's provider names (src/components/assistant/providerMarks.tsx) are
  the "openai" and "claude" icons of simple-icons 16.35.0 (https://simpleicons.org), dedicated to the
  public domain under CC0 1.0. OpenAI and Claude are trademarks of their owners; the marks only say
  which service answers and do not mean that the owners endorse Inkwell.
